edges.reason: openPacks uses msg.sender as the recipient of pulled packs and minted cards
swapCards uses msg.sender for NFT balance check, burns and mints
random() mixes msg.sender into the randomness hash
withdraw_all is gated by onlyClevel which compares msg.sender to walletA, walletB or owner
setWalletA requires msg.sender to equal walletA
setWalletB requires msg.sender to equal walletB
block.timestamp is the primary entropy source of the weak randomness operation
random() depends on block.timestamp, making draws miner-influenceable
walletA is part of the onlyClevel authorization check in withdraw_all
walletB is part of the onlyClevel authorization check in withdraw_all
walletBPercentage feeds the balance division/multiplication computing the payout amounts
swapFee is compared against msg.value in swapCards
nftAddress is queried with balanceOf to decide whether the swap fee is due
lastUnpackedByAddress is written with the freshly drawn base and founder cards
lastUnpackedByAddress is overwritten with the replacement cards after a swap
cardDealer is the target of the external randomCards call
nonce is read and incremented inside random()
founderPackAddress is compared to packContract to decide founder card minting
cardsPerNormalPack multiplies the loaded amount into base cards
activeDeck is forwarded as the deck argument to randomCards
openPacks calls the SafeERC20 safeTransferFrom wrapper on an arbitrary token address
openPacks calls the external card dealer to draw base cards
openPacks mints card NFTs to msg.sender
swapCards calls the external card dealer for replacement cards
swapCards mints replacement cards to msg.sender
swapCards burns the caller supplied cards before minting new ones
random() builds its output from the weak randomness operation
withdraw_all sends the majority share to walletA with a plain transfer
withdraw_all sends the percentage share to walletB with a plain transfer
If msg.sender is a contract, _mint invokes onERC1155Received, allowing reentry into openPacks while lastUnpackedByAddress is only partly written
If msg.sender is a contract, _mint invokes onERC1155Received, allowing reentry into swapCards mid-loop
The untrusted cardDealer contract is called before all state updates complete and can call back into openPacks
The user supplied packContract address is passed directly as the ERC20 token to safeTransferFrom
packContract is used in openPacks for the founder pack comparison
_amount bounds the pack pull, card count and loops in openPacks
_cardsToSwap drives the burn loop and random draw length in swapCards
_range is the modulo operand in random()
_user is the mapping key read in lastUnpackedCards
_nft is stored into nftAddress by setNFTAddress
_fee is stored into swapFee by setSwapFee
_walletA is stored into walletA by setWalletA
_walletB is stored into walletB by setWalletB
_percentage is stored into walletBPercentage by setWalletBPercentage
amountBaseCards is passed as the draw amount to cardDealer.randomCards
amountFounderCards contributes to the size of the lastUnpackedByAddress array and mint loop

Each drawn newCard id is minted to msg.sender during a swap
rnd is the computed pseudo-random result returned by random()
amountA is the value transferred to walletA
amountB is the value transferred to walletB
The computed founder card id is minted to msg.sender
